summary: Telomir Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing a private placement (PIPE) of 4,843,300 common shares at $1.16 per share, a 5% discount to the 10-day VWAP, for gross proceeds of roughly $5.6 million. The shares carried no warrants, convertibles or reset features; existing significant shareholder John Paul DeJoria invested an additional $1.0 million. Alexander Capital acted as placement agent for a 9.0% cash fee (~$455,000). The company must file a resale registration statement within 30 days. Proceeds fund the Telomir-Zn Phase 1/2 triple-negative breast cancer program and working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch resale-registration timing and dilution overhang.
